Frontend: all Playwright flows green — More filters panel toggles and submits without errors, clicking a profile card opens ProfileView with all action buttons, Like disables + shows toast + back returns to /browse, admin flow reaches /admin → Prices tab, admin-referral-bonus persists across reload, and settings restored to defaults. Language switcher lists all 11 languages (ru,en,es,fr,de,pt,zh,hi,bn,ur,ar); Urdu sets document.documentElement.dir=rtl.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_profiles: two-query 'boost premium then rest' pattern (lines 387–393) doesn't paginate correctly across pages and duplicates the conds filter. Should switch to a single aggregation with $addFields boost=$cond → $sort boost desc for stable pagination and less code.

server.py update_me (line 294): PATCH accepts explicit `null` for photos as "skip" (since model_dump excludes only None) — but clients wanting to CLEAR arrays (hobbies, languages_spoken) cannot send [] distinctly from omitted. Consider exclude_unset=True on model_dump instead of the current v is not None filter, so empty lists/strings are preservable.

admin_put_settings (line 661): saves gifts/coin_packages verbatim, but doesn't validate uniqueness of gift.id / package.id — a duplicate id silently breaks _find_gift (returns only the first match). Add: assert len({g.id for g in req.gifts}) == len(req.gifts).

AdminPrices.jsx: commission_pct is Math.round()ed on load then divided by 100 on save — a defaults commission of 0.30 round-trips correctly, but any admin-set value like 0.33 would be silently truncated to 0.33 (fine) while 0.335 → 0.34. Consider input step=0.1 and store as decimal.

ProfileView.jsx line 33: on load failure the toast+redirect fires on ANY error, including transient 401 during token refresh. Consider checking err.response?.status === 404 specifically before redirecting to /browse.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral users prefixed test_iter4_ / iter4v2_ registered via API and UI. Admin settings mutated then restored to defaults so other flows are unaffected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter4 tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_giftsdates_iter4.py. Run with default pytest (xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope, per /app/backend/pytest.ini). The initial UI localStorage.getItem('user') returned null in first attempt — the AppContext apparently stores user in state only, so use DOM data-testids to locate profile ids rather than localStorage. profile-card-open-<uid> selectors are stable and reliable.
